event: Contact with hot objects or substances
narrative: On September 29, 2025, an employee was removing a pan of pasta from the stove when the pan tipped over. Hot water contacted her legs and feet, resulting in burns to both feet that required hospitalization.

event: Struck by running powered equipment during maintenance, cleaning, testing
narrative: An employee was clearing a jam on a production line. A machine cycled; its auger rotated and amputated the employee's left index fingertip.

event: Struck by running powered equipment n.e.c.
narrative: An employee was cleaning a part on a pedestal grinder. The employee's middle finger contacted the abrasive wheel, resulting in a partial amputation.

event: Hitting, kicking, beating by other person while providing medical or custodial care
narrative: An employee was working to de-escalate an aggressive patient in the hallway when they were attacked, suffering a concussion and bruised ribs.

event: Struck by other falling object n.e.c.
source: Gates, hatches vehicle and machine cargo
narrative: An employee was installing a door on a semi-trailer. They were using a forklift to lift the door to the height of the trailer when the door became jammed between the forklift mast and the hinge on the trailer. When the employee went to dislodge the door from the mast, the door fell and crushed their foot. Their big toe was amputated. The employee was hospitalized and their big toe was surgically reattached. The employee's foot and other toes also required surgery.

event: Caught, entangled in running powered equipment normal operation
narrative: An employee was being trained on a winding machine when his glove became stuck on tape. While freeing his glove, the machine was activated and started winding. His arm was pulled into the machine, resulting in a fractured left forearm.

event: Fall on same level n.e.c.
narrative: At 7:40 a.m. on October 3, 2025, an employee was unloading a bulkhead at a dock door. As he pulled the bulkhead out of a trailer, its plastic lip caught on the dock plate, causing the employee to fall and twist his left leg, knee, and hip. The hip was broken and he was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

nature: Multiple severe wounds and internal injuries
event: Other fall to lower level more than 30 feet
source: Suspended or hanging scaffolds or staging
narrative: An employee was blasting a water tower. They fell approximately 60 feet off a suspended scaffold and sustained broken vertebrae, a compound fracture of the tibia, a fractured heel, and a rupture to their liver. The employee was hospitalized.

event: Struck by discharged object or substance
narrative: An employee was sandblasting paint from a water tower when the blasting media sprayed across their forearm, resulting in an elbow injury that required hospitalization.

event: Struck by running powered equipment during maintenance, cleaning, testing
source: Other metal, wood, and special material machinery n.e.c.
narrative: An employee was cutting hanks of material on an abrasive cutter. A hank end opened up. As the employee was working to clear loose material, the machine was triggered and amputated 1/4 inch of his right middle fingertip.

event: Slip, trip, stumble while stepping between levels
narrative: An employee was dropping customers off with a shuttle. He stepped out of the shuttle and his foot entered a pothole, causing him to twist his ankle and then fall to the ground. The employee sustained multiple dislocations to the ankle requiring surgery.

nature: Closed trauma involving internal organs, major blood vessels
event: Pedestrian struck by forward-moving vehicle in nonroadway area
narrative: A backhoe tractor was moving gravel into a 1-foot-deep trench, and an employee was helping spread the gravel. The trench had been partly filled and the tractor was returning to it with a load of stone when its raised bucket struck the employee, who was standing in the trench. He was hospitalized, having suffered an abdominal injury that caused internal bleeding.

nature: Infections of the skin and subcutaneous tissue unspecified
event: Kneeling, crawling
source: Bodily motion or position of injured, ill worker
narrative: An employee was working on flooring tile, which required several continuous hours of kneeling. The next morning, he noticed fluid and swelling on the right knee. When he knelt to perform work tasks, he felt an immediate sharp, burning pain. The employee was hospitalized with an infection.

nature: Cuts, lacerations, punctures without injury to internal structures
event: Struck by door, gate, window
narrative: A restroom stall door swung open, bounced back at the employee, and the coat hook on the door impaled his left eye. He was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

employer: K. & M. Electric of Schofield, Inc.
event: Struck by falling object unspecified
narrative: An employee was dismantling a decommissioned electrical panel when the unit fell on him, resulting in a compound fracture in his leg and a broken arm that required hospitalization.

event: Struck by rolling, sliding, or shifting objects non-running
narrative: An employee was adjusting a cable reel that was loaded onto the forks of a forklift. The reel shifted and caught the employee's left index fingertip against the backrest, amputating it.

event: Struck by running powered equipment n.e.c.
narrative: An employee was operating a saw when their right hand contacted the blade(s), resulting in amputation of four fingers and a partial thumb amputation.

event: Struck by propelled, falling, or suspended object unspecified
narrative: An employee was repositioning a large casting with a chain. The chain slipped and landed on his hand, resulting in hospitalization with a fracture to his upper arm and a crushing injury to his thumb.

event: Struck by rolling, sliding, or shifting objects non-running
narrative: An employee was maneuvering a 500-pound spin plate from a lower rack. While the plate was being rolled, it went out of control, injured the employee's left bicep, and then rolled over his left foot resulting in a crushing injury to the foot as well as contusions to the torso and left leg. The employee was hospitalized.

event: Indirect exposure to electricity greater than 220 volts
narrative: An employee was guiding the pouring end of a concrete pump truck's boom while standing on top of 4-foot wall forms. The boom contacted power lines and the employee was shocked. The employee sustained third-degree burns on the entry and exit path of the electricity, and also sustained first- and second-degree burns to their torso and legs.

event: Struck by running powered equipment during maintenance, cleaning, testing
narrative: An employee was assisting with maintenance and servicing a conveyor that was making an unusual noise. The employee's right arm got caught in the conveyor between a belt and a roller. Their right hand and arm were crushed, resulting in amputation of the arm.

event: Other fall to lower level unspecified
narrative: An employee was on an A-frame ladder, installing a drip edge as part of a gutter installation. The employee fell to the ground, suffered a head laceration and a concussion, and was hospitalized.

event: Fall on same level n.e.c.
narrative: An employee was pulling a display shipper using the provided strap. The strap broke and the employee fell to the floor, suffering a broken wrist.

event: Caught, entangled in running powered equipment normal operation
narrative: On October 21, 2025, an employee was operating a saw when a pneumatic clamp caught their right middle finger. The employee suffered a partial amputation to the finger.

event: Caught, entangled in running powered equipment normal operation
narrative: A marine diver/construction worker was working underwater, using a hydraulic dredge to clear sediment away from the base of a dam. The dredge's suction nozzle began migrating toward him, and then pulled in his right hand and forearm. He sustained compartment syndrome in the hand and forearm.

body: Exterior and musculoskeletal structures of the neck
event: Nonroadway noncollision vehicle overturn
narrative: An employee was mowing a residential lawn at a client's house. The mower slid on the land and tipped over onto him. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured vertebra in the neck and partial paralysis.

event: Caught, entangled in running powered equipment normal operation
narrative: An employee was using a de-clipping machine to cut the metal clips off of sausage sticks. As the employee put a link of sausages into the machine, their hand slipped into the point of operation. A piston pinched the employee's left index finger, causing a partial amputation.

event: Other fall to lower level more than 30 feet
narrative: An employee was laying glue on the corner of a three-story commercial flat roof to apply new thermoplastic polyolefin roofing material. He lost his balance and fell at least 35 feet to the concrete ground below. The employee sustained fractures.

event: Struck by running powered equipment during maintenance, cleaning, testing
source: Other metal, wood, and special material machinery n.e.c.
narrative: An employee was performing maintenance on a roll cutting machine in a warehouse. The employee was removing excess grease from the bearings when the machine's chain caught their right index finger. The fingertip was amputated by the chain and sprocket.

event: Fall on same level due to slip or trip
narrative: An employee was carrying a plastic tote full of brake rotors. His foot caught the corner of a pallet, causing him to fall to the concrete floor and break his hip.

event: Caught, entangled in running powered equipment normal operation
source: Food and beverage processing machinery n.e.c.
narrative: An employee was cleaning a depositor machine to setup for a new product run. His right index finger was caught by moving parts in the depositor machine and the fingertip was partially amputated without bone loss.

event: Other fall to lower level unspecified
narrative: An employee was unloading a truck for a delivery job. While moving boxes in the truck, the employee tripped over a pallet and fell out of the truck to the ground, resulting in four broken ribs.

event: Struck by running powered equipment n.e.c.
narrative: An employee was using a vertical band saw to cut a thick piece of rubber material. While being cut, the material shifted, causing the employee s right hand to contact the moving blade. The employee's thumb was amputated below the knuckle. The employee was hospitalized, undergoing surgery.

event: Struck by running powered equipment during maintenance, cleaning, testing
narrative: A production sanitation employee was pre-rinsing an incline conveyor and noticed cheese stuck between the belt idler. The employee went to remove the cheese and their glove got caught and pulled their left forearm into the conveyor. The employee's arm was fractured. The machine was not locked out/tagged out at the time.

event: Fall to lower level from collapsing structure or equipment unspecified
narrative: An employee was on a ladder, taking measurements for a new gutter installation. The ladder slipped out from under him and both he and the ladder fell to the ground. He was hospitalized with seven broken ribs and a broken clavicle.

event: Struck by other falling object n.e.c.
narrative: The injured employee was assisting five other employees with bracing a wall panel that was being stood up. Another employee slipped on frost on the floor surface. The employees went to evacuate the area in anticipation of the wall panel falling over. The injured employee went to jump through a window opening within the wall panel and their lower half was crushed by the falling wall panel. The employee sustained a fractured pelvis.

event: Fall, contact incident onboard water vehicle
narrative: An employee on a material transport barge was working to fasten a strap underneath a 7-inch schedule 40 pipe and used a crane to raise one end of it. When the end of the pipe was raised approximately 18 inches, the crane hook slipped out and the pipe fell onto the employee's right foot, crushing it. The employee sustained fractures to their toes and a metatarsal bone.

street: North 6th St. and West McKinley Ave.
event: Struck by suspended or swinging objects n.e.c.
narrative: An employee was reaching for a precast panel that was being hoisted by a crane to make a connection to a building. A gust of wind caused the panel to shift and the employee's hand became pinched between the panel and an existing metal stud frame knee wall. The employee sustained a partial fingertip amputation.

event: Contact with hot objects or substances
narrative: An employee was taking a sample from a sample port. A steam valve failed near the port, and hot steam burned the left side of the employee's torso and head, as well as their left hip and leg.

event: Other fall to lower level less than 6 feet
narrative: An employee was using a step ladder to access a sleeve of wing containers. She misstepped while descending the ladder and fell to the floor, resulting in fractures to her leg and arm.

employer: St. Vincent Hospital of the Hospital Sisters of the Third Order of St. Francis, Inc.
event: Hitting, kicking, beating by other person while providing medical or custodial care
narrative: A security officer was working to redirect a patient who was in the hallway when the patient struck his face, causing him to fall to the floor. The employee suffered four fractured ribs that required hospitalization.

employer: Wal-Mart Stores East I, Limited Partnership (Regd Name) Wal-Mart Stores East, LP (Part Name)
event: Collision with stationary object, nonroadway
narrative: An employee was driving a power lift toward a shipping dock. The lift ran over protective bollards, and the employee's right lower leg was pinched between the lift and the bollards. He suffered a broken fibula and was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

event: Caught or wedged between objects nonrunning
source: Mixers, blenders, whippers food and beverage
narrative: An employee was manually rotating a mixer's drive belt. As the employee was trying to locate a part number on the belt, a pinch point on a gear under the belt caught their right hand. The employee sustained amputation of the middle and ring fingertips.

event: Struck by running powered equipment during maintenance, cleaning, testing
narrative: An employee was working at a finger joint line when a board got stuck on the finger jointer. The employee attempted to remove the board when the machine's roller pinched her right middle finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

event: Struck by rolling, sliding, or shifting objects non-running
narrative: An employee was using a crane to pick up and readjust a 300-pound machined part on a pallet. When the part was picked up, it shifted and caught the employee's left little finger against the crane's J-hook, causing amputation of the fingertip.

event: Walking, without other incident
source: Bodily motion or position of injured, ill worker
narrative: An employee was preparing to deliver groceries at a customer s location. After staging the truck for unloading, he walked to the building and unlocked the customer s door. While walking back toward the truck, the employee felt a sudden sharp pain in his lower and mid back, causing him to drop to the ground. He was hospitalized due to a strain or sprain.

event: Struck by rolling powered vehicle or machinery
source: Forklift, order picker, platform truck powered
narrative: An employee was working to jumpstart a welding machine with a forklift. They were operating the controls of the forklift from outside of the forklift when the forklift moved and pinned the employee against a pallet rack, resulting in a fractured hip.

event: Fall on same level due to slip or trip
narrative: An employee was walking through a floral department when she slipped and fell on a floor that had been waxed the previous night. The employee sustained fractures to their right shoulder and three ribs.

nature: Cuts, lacerations, punctures without injury to internal structures
event: Struck by running powered equipment n.e.c.
narrative: An employee was using a 10-inch table saw to cut jambs for interior doors. After finishing a cut, the saw blade contacted the top of his right hand and index finger, resulting in lacerations that required hospitalization.

event: Collision with stationary object, nonroadway
source: Trucks with other mounted machinery, equipment n.e.c.
narrative: An employee and crew were using a line truck to set a pole. The employee was standing at the rear of the vehicle operating the external gear controls. When he engaged the high-RPM function using the control switch, the truck began moving backward. The employee was pinned between the rear of the truck and a job trailer, resulting in multiple fractures in pelvic area/midsection and internal contusions.

event: Fall to lower level from collapsing structure or equipment 6 to 30 feet
source: Industrial vehicle, material hauling and transport powered, n.e.c.
narrative: An employee was on a work platform elevated by a telehandler, and was working on the side of a new post-and-frame building. They were grabbing a piece of building material when the work platform detached from the telehandler, causing them to fall 8 to 9 feet down to the surface level. The employee sustained a fractured vertebra and a fractured left hip.

event: Fall on same level due to slip or trip
narrative: The injured employee was walking out a main entrance door being held by another employee. The injured employee's walker caught the bottom threshold of the doorframe, causing them to fall to the concrete sidewalk and sustain a fractured femur.

event: Other fall to lower level unspecified
narrative: An employee was standing on a hill with wet grass. She adjusted her stance while working with a client when she fell down the hill. The employee suffered a dislocated and broken ankle, as well as a broken tibia and fibula.

event: Struck by running powered equipment irregular movement, kick back
narrative: An employee was using a table saw to split poplar wood planks measuring 3 inches wide by 8 feet long. He stopped feeding the material into the saw to reach over the saw for a push stick to finish the cut. His right hand was on the end of the material to hold it in place in front of the saw blade when the board tried to kick upward. He placed his left hand on the board behind the saw blade when the board caught on the spinning blade and pulled the board and his left hand into the blade. The employee's middle and index fingers caught on the blade, resulting in amputations that required hospitalization and surgery.

event: Struck by running powered equipment unspecified
narrative: An employee was removing defective packages from a bin on a packaging line. Their left ring finger was caught by a rotating shaft in the packaging conveyor system, resulting in the amputation of the entire finger.

event: Caught, entangled in running powered equipment normal operation
narrative: An employee was packaging a roll. They were applying edge guard to a roll when their right hand became caught between the roll and the packer side idler, resulting in an avulsion to the top of their right hand.

event: Caught or wedged between objects nonrunning
narrative: An employee was grinding bevels into a stiffener (flat steel bar that is installed perpendicular to an I-beam). He finished the bevel on one side and was pushing the stiffener away from himself to flip it over. His right middle finger became caught between the stiffener and the flange of the beam which weighed approximately 200 pounds. The employee sustained a partial amputation/avulsion of their fingertip.

event: Fall on same level due to slip or trip
narrative: A temporary employee was moving a pallet and noticed plastic wrap underneath. When he went to move the plastic wrap, he slipped on another piece of plastic and fell to the cement floor on his hip. The employee sustained a fractured hip.

event: Caught, entangled in running powered equipment normal operation
narrative: An employee was training on the edger (watching the edger operator) when his index finger got pinched between the guard and the metal board stop. The employee sustained a laceration, fracture, and dislocated joint in the finger. He was hospitalized and required surgery.

body: Exterior and musculoskeletal structures of the back unspecified
event: Fall on same level due to slip or trip
narrative: A temporary employee was cleaning a machine toward the end of their shift when they tripped on a hose and impacted a metal beam. The employee sustained a laceration to their head and a fractured vertebra.

event: Struck by running powered equipment during maintenance, cleaning, testing
source: Food and beverage processing machinery n.e.c.
narrative: The employee was listening for a noise at a cooling rack. His hand was caught by the in-running nip point of an unenergized roller and an energized wire belt. The wire belt cut his fingertip, resulting in amputation. The machine was not locked out/tagged out at the time.
